proves.claim: With relay.queueOnFailure on and an unreadable board key, claim 1, shout all and answer yes each exit 0 and apply on the local board.

cli.journeys-relay-outbox-auth.unreadabl.why: Without it, a regression where an unreadable key fails a local command would pass unnoticed: the unit tests cover the queueable codes, not the real linked moves.

proves.claim: Each move made under an unreadable key is kept in relay-outbox.unsealed.json with no key field, and none reaches the relay.

cli.journeys-relay-outbox-auth.unreadabl.why: Without it, a regression that leaks the key into the key-free outbox or sends a move early would pass unnoticed.
